document.title: Question Investigation Workbench — Workflow Model
document.author: Board I — Investigation Workbench Prototype
document.purpose: Define the complete investigation workflow experienced by a human investigator resolving question-quality issues in the CMA Part 1 Exam Simulator.

dependencies.Board_A: Question Investigation API — full dossier generation
dependencies.Board_C: Challenge Triage Engine — incoming challenge categorization
dependencies.Board_D: Investigation Registry — lifecycle tracking and persistence
dependencies.Board_E: Question Health Engine — severity and impact assessment
dependencies.Board_F: Session Intelligence — exposure tracing and learner impact analysis
dependencies.Board_H: Admin Data Contract — permission enforcement and role definitions
dependencies.GovernanceGuard: Pre-write validation rules (DL-008, DL-026, Rule 2, Rule 6)

stateMachine.description: The master state machine governing the lifecycle of every question-quality investigation from student challenge to final resolution.

TRIGGERED.label: Triggered
TRIGGERED.description: A new investigation has been created from a student challenge, automated sweep, or manual flag.
entryCriteria: Valid ChallengeRecord submitted via Challenge API with non-empty QID
Or: automated defect-sweep scan produces a finding with confidence ≥ 80%
Or: manual investigator flag on a question via admin dashboard
Challenge must reference a valid QuestionID in an existing pack file
Duplicate-detection: if an OPEN investigation already exists for the same QID, merge rather than duplicate
exitCriteria: Triage classification assigned (severity, type, priority)
Registry record created with unique InvestigationID
Investigation linked to at least one QuestionID

availableActions.label: Run Initial Triage
availableActions.description: Invoke the Challenge Triage Engine (Board C) to auto-classify the incoming challenge by severity, type, and priority.
postconditions: severity, type, and priority fields set
State transitions to TRIAGED if auto-classification confidence ≥ 70%; otherwise remains TRIGGERED for manual triage
availableActions.uiComponent: button (auto-trigger on creation or manual re-run)

availableActions.label: Manual Triage
availableActions.description: Investigator manually classifies the challenge when auto-triage confidence is below threshold.

availableActions.label: Merge with Existing
availableActions.description: Merge this challenge into an existing OPEN investigation for the same QID.
preconditions: Another investigation with same QID exists and is in a non-terminal state
postconditions: Current challenge appended to parent investigation's challenge list

requiredData.challengeId: string — unique identifier of the triggering challenge
requiredData.qidList: string[] — one or more QuestionIDs under investigation
requiredData.triggerSource: string — student ID, sweep script name, or investigator ID
requiredData.rawChallengeText: string — verbatim challenge text from student or sweep output

sla.escalationIfExceeded: Notify lead investigator via dashboard alert

TRIAGED.label: Triaged
TRIAGED.description: The investigation has been classified by severity, type, and priority. Awaiting assignment to an investigator.
entryCriteria: TriageResult populated with severity, type, priority
Investigation record created in Registry (Board D)
All required TRIGGERED data fields populated
exitCriteria: AssignedInvestigator field populated (user ID or team)
assignmentTimestamp recorded

availableActions.label: Assign Investigator
availableActions.description: Assign this investigation to a specific investigator or team based on workload, expertise, and severity.

availableActions.label: Auto-Assign
availableActions.description: Let the system auto-assign based on investigator workload, domain expertise, and current queue depth.
preconditions: At least one investigator is available

availableActions.label: Escalate Immediately
availableActions.description: Bypass normal workflow — escalate directly to governance team. Used for CRITICAL severity items requiring immediate attention.
availableActions.uiComponent: button (confirmation modal with required reason field)

availableActions.label: Run Full Dossier
availableActions.description: Invoke Question Investigation API (Board A) to generate a complete dossier for all linked QIDs.
postconditions: dossierCache populated with full question data, metadata, explanations, history
dataOutputs: fullDossier { qid, packFile, section, topic, questionState, correctChoice, choices, explanations, metadata, revisionHistory }

availableActions.label: Dismiss as False Positive
availableActions.description: Mark the challenge as a false positive — e.g., student error, not a question defect.
preconditions: Investigator confirms no question defect exists

triageResult.severity: enum: CRITICAL | HIGH | MEDIUM | LOW | INFORMATIONAL
triageResult.type: enum: CORRECTNESS | EXPLANATION | STRUCTURAL | METADATA | PEDAGOGICAL | DUPLICATE | OTHER

requiredData.affectedPacks: string[] — pack files containing the affected QID(s)

sla.escalationIfExceeded: Auto-escalate to team lead if not assigned within SLA window

ASSIGNED.label: Assigned
ASSIGNED.description: An investigator has been assigned and has acknowledged the investigation. Work has not yet begun.
entryCriteria: AssignedInvestigator field populated
assignmentTimestamp recorded
Investigator has acknowledged assignment (optional: configurable per team)
exitCriteria: Investigator transitions state to INVESTIGATING via Accept Investigation action
Or: reassigned to another investigator (remains ASSIGNED)
Or: escalated

availableActions.label: Accept Investigation
availableActions.description: The assigned investigator formally accepts the investigation and begins work. Transitions to INVESTIGATING.
preconditions: Caller is the assigned investigator or has ADMIN role

availableActions.label: Reassign
availableActions.description: Reassign this investigation to a different investigator or team.

availableActions.label: Request More Info
availableActions.description: Request additional information from the challenge originator before proceeding.
availableActions.uiComponent: form (modal with text area and field picker)

availableActions.label: Run Full Dossier
availableActions.description: Invoke Question Investigation API (Board A) to generate a complete dossier.

sla.escalationIfExceeded: Flag investigation as overdue; notify team lead; auto-reassign if no response in +24h

INVESTIGATING.label: Investigating
INVESTIGATING.description: Active investigation in progress. Investigator is analyzing data, running tools, and recording findings.
entryCriteria: Investigator has accepted the investigation
investigationStartTimestamp recorded
exitCriteria: At least one FindingRecord exists
Investigator transitions state to FINDINGS_DRAFT or ESCALATED

availableActions.label: Run Full Dossier
availableActions.description: Refresh the full question dossier from Board A API.

availableActions.label: Run Health Assessment
availableActions.description: Invoke Question Health Engine (Board E) to assess severity, learner-pool impact, and certification risk.

availableActions.label: Trace Session Impact
availableActions.description: Invoke Session Intelligence (Board F) to trace how many learner sessions have been exposed to the affected QID.
availableActions.uiComponent: button (async — may take longer for large data)

availableActions.label: Add Finding
availableActions.description: Record a specific finding discovered during investigation. Each finding captures evidence, severity, and links to known defect patterns.
postconditions: New FindingRecord appended to findings array

dataInputs.findingType: enum: ANSWER_ERROR | EXPLANATION_DEFECT | STRUCTURAL_DEFECT | METADATA_ISSUE | DISTRACTOR_QUALITY | PEDAGOGICAL_ISSUE | OTHER
dataInputs.severity: enum: CRITICAL | HIGH | MEDIUM | LOW | INFORMATIONAL
dataInputs.title: string — one-line summary (max 120 chars)
dataInputs.evidence: string[] — file references or inline evidence
dataInputs.confirmationMethod: enum: INDEPENDENT_RECALCULATION | STANDARD_REFERENCE | AUTOMATED_SCAN | MANUAL_REVIEW | EXPERT_CONSULTATION

availableActions.uiComponent: form (slide-out panel or modal, rich text)

availableActions.label: Link Defect
availableActions.description: Link this finding to a known defect entry in DEFECT_LIBRARY.md (e.g., DL-008, DL-026).
availableActions.uiComponent: searchable dropdown + confirm button (inline on finding card)

availableActions.label: Link Additional QID
availableActions.description: Add another affected QuestionID to this investigation (e.g., clone group, rotation artifact).
availableActions.uiComponent: form (inline add with autocomplete QID search)

availableActions.label: Attach Evidence
availableActions.description: Upload or link supporting evidence — screenshots, calculation workpapers, standard references, scan outputs.
dataInputs: evidenceType: SCREENSHOT | CALC_WORKPAPER | STANDARD_CITATION | SCAN_OUTPUT | COMMUNICATION | OTHER

availableActions.label: Request Peer Review
availableActions.description: Request a second investigator to review a specific finding.
availableActions.uiComponent: button on finding card → modal with reviewer selector

availableActions.label: Complete Investigation — Draft Findings
availableActions.description: Move the investigation to findings drafting phase. All findings should be recorded.
preconditions: All linked QIDs have been analyzed
availableActions.uiComponent: button (primary CTA — confirmation modal with summary field)

availableActions.label: Escalate to Governance
availableActions.description: Escalate to the governance team — used when the defect has systemic implications, requires policy change, or exceeds investigator authority.
availableActions.uiComponent: button (confirmation modal with required fields, styled as destructive action)

requiredData.dossierCache: object — Board A full dossier for all linked QIDs
requiredData.sessionTrace: object (optional) — Board F session impact data

sla.escalationIfExceeded: Auto-notify team lead; flag in overdue queue; escalate if no progress in +3 days

FINDINGS_DRAFT.label: Findings Draft
FINDINGS_DRAFT.description: Findings have been documented. Awaiting review before action planning.
entryCriteria: At least one FindingRecord exists
Investigator has submitted findings for review
exitCriteria: All findings reviewed (self-review or peer review)
Investigation transitions to FINDINGS_REVIEW or back to INVESTIGATING if more work needed

availableActions.label: Review Findings
availableActions.description: Self-review or peer-review the draft findings for completeness, accuracy, and clarity.
postconditions: FindingRecords marked as reviewed with reviewer ID and timestamp
availableActions.uiComponent: form per finding (approve/reject/notes, inline or accordion)

availableActions.label: Request External Review
availableActions.description: Request review from a domain expert (Accountant, Psychometrician per COLLABORATION_MATRIX.md).
availableActions.uiComponent: form (modal with role selector, scope, and deadline picker)

availableActions.label: Amend Finding
availableActions.description: Edit an existing finding based on review feedback.
preconditions: Finding exists and is in DRAFT or NEEDS_REVISION status

availableActions.label: Submit for Final Review
availableActions.description: Submit draft findings for formal review before action planning.
preconditions: All findings have been reviewed (self or peer)

availableActions.label: Return to Investigating
availableActions.description: Go back to active investigation — more analysis needed.
availableActions.uiComponent: button (secondary, with confirmation and reason field)

requiredData.findings: FindingRecord[] — all findings in reviewed status

sla.standard: Part of the 14-day FINDINGS_DRAFT → RESOLVED window
sla.critical: Part of the 7-day FINDINGS_DRAFT → RESOLVED window

FINDINGS_REVIEW.label: Findings Review
FINDINGS_REVIEW.description: Findings are under formal review. Decision point: proceed to action, dismiss, or escalate.
entryCriteria: All findings marked as reviewed
Investigation in FINDINGS_DRAFT and transitioned to FINDINGS_REVIEW
exitCriteria: Decision made: ACTION_PLANNED (remediation needed), DISMISSED (no action), or ESCALATED (governance)

availableActions.label: Approve & Plan Action
availableActions.description: Approve findings and proceed to action planning. At least one defect requires remediation.
preconditions: At least one finding has severity ≥ CRITICAL or HIGH that requires remediation

availableActions.label: Dismiss Investigation
availableActions.description: Findings do not warrant action. Investigation is dismissed. (e.g., finding is informational-only, false positive confirmed, or out of scope.)
preconditions: No findings require remediation (all INFORMATIONAL or LOW with accepted risk)
dataInputs: dismissalType: FALSE_POSITIVE | INFORMATIONAL_ONLY | OUT_OF_SCOPE | ACCEPTED_RISK | DUPLICATE
availableActions.uiComponent: button (warning-styled, confirmation modal with required reason and type)

availableActions.label: Escalate to Governance
availableActions.description: Findings have systemic implications requiring governance review — policy changes, certification block-listing, or pack-wide remediation.
preconditions: At least one finding is systemic (affects multiple QIDs, packs, or policy)
availableActions.uiComponent: button (warning-styled, modal with comprehensive escalation form)

sla.standard: Part of the 14-day FINDINGS_DRAFT → RESOLVED window
sla.critical: Part of the 7-day FINDINGS_DRAFT → RESOLVED window

ACTION_PLANNED.label: Action Planned
ACTION_PLANNED.description: A remediation plan has been drafted. Awaiting approval and execution.
entryCriteria: At least one ActionItem in the remediation plan
Approval obtained from reviewer (unless self-approved per role)
exitCriteria: All ActionItems approved
Execution begins with first EXECUTE_REMEDIATION action

availableActions.label: Create Remediation Plan
availableActions.description: Build a remediation plan with one or more action items, each linked to specific findings.

actionItems.actionType: enum: CLEAR_FIELD | REWRITE_EXPLANATION | CORRECT_ANSWER | ADD_FIELD | REMOVE_BOILERPLATE | RECALIBRATE_DIFFICULTY | ARCHIVE_QID | MARK_STATE | OTHER
actionItems.estimatedEffort: enum: TRIVIAL | MINOR | MODERATE | MAJOR | COMPLEX

availableActions.uiComponent: builder UI (drag-and-drop action items, inline editing, linked finding cards)

availableActions.label: Validate Against Governance Guard
availableActions.description: Pre-flight check: run the remediation plan against governance guard rules to predict blocking issues.
preconditions: RemediationPlan exists with at least one ActionItem
dataOutputs: GovernanceValidationResult { passedActions: string[], blockedActions: string[], warnings: string[] }

availableActions.label: Request Action Approval
availableActions.description: Submit the remediation plan for approval by a reviewer or governance officer.
preconditions: Governance guard validation passed for all actions

availableActions.label: Execute Remediation
availableActions.description: Begin executing the remediation plan. Each ActionItem is processed sequentially or in parallel (batch).

availableActions.label: Return to Findings Review
availableActions.description: Go back — findings need revision before action planning.

remediationPlan.totalEstimatedEffort: enum: TRIVIAL | MINOR | MODERATE | MAJOR | COMPLEX

sla.standard: Part of the 14-day FINDINGS_DRAFT → RESOLVED window
sla.critical: Part of the 7-day FINDINGS_DRAFT → RESOLVED window

ACTION_EXECUTING.label: Action Executing
ACTION_EXECUTING.description: Remediation actions are being executed. Backups are being made. Pack files are being modified.
entryCriteria: RemediationPlan approved
EXECUTE_REMEDIATION action triggered
exitCriteria: All ActionItems executed
Backup files created for all modified pack files
Investigation transitions to ACTION_VERIFIED

availableActions.label: Execute Single Action Item
availableActions.description: Execute one action item from the remediation plan. For batch actions, execute the entire batch.
postconditions: ActionItem status updated to EXECUTED or FAILED
Backup file created if pack file modified
availableActions.uiComponent: button per action item (with progress indicator, backup confirmation, governance check result)

availableActions.label: Execute All Actions
availableActions.description: Execute all pending action items sequentially. Batch-aware — respects governance guard Rule 5 (max 30 items per change-set).
postconditions: State transitions to ACTION_VERIFIED (if all succeeded)
dataOutputs: batchExecutionResult { successful: ActionItem[], failed: ActionItem[], backupFiles: string[] }
availableActions.uiComponent: button (primary CTA — shows batch progress bar, per-item status)
availableActions.timeout: varies — up to 5 minutes for large batches

availableActions.label: Rollback Action
availableActions.description: Restore a pack file from its pre-execution backup. Action item status reverted to PENDING.
preconditions: Backup file exists for the affected pack file
ActionItem status is EXECUTED or FAILED

availableActions.label: Skip Action
availableActions.description: Skip an action item — used when execution is blocked or the action is no longer needed.
availableActions.uiComponent: button per action item (confirmation with required reason)

availableActions.label: Pause Execution
availableActions.description: Pause batch execution — used when an issue is detected mid-batch.
postconditions: Execution paused at current action item

availableActions.label: Resume Execution
availableActions.description: Resume a paused batch execution.
postconditions: Execution resumes from next pending action item

requiredData.backupFiles: string[] — paths to created backup files

sla.standard: Part of the 14-day FINDINGS_DRAFT → RESOLVED window
sla.critical: Part of the 7-day FINDINGS_DRAFT → RESOLVED window

ACTION_VERIFIED.label: Action Verified
ACTION_VERIFIED.description: All remediation actions have been executed. Verification is in progress — confirming fixes, running validators, checking for regressions.
entryCriteria: All ActionItems in EXECUTED or SKIPPED status
No ActionItems in FAILED status (or failed items acknowledged and skipped)
exitCriteria: All verification checks passed
Investigation transitions to RESOLVED
Or: returned to ACTION_EXECUTING if verification fails

availableActions.label: Run Validator Suite
availableActions.description: Run the full automated validator suite on affected pack files. Check for zero new errors and zero regressions.
dataOutputs: ValidatorResult { errors: string[], warnings: string[], regressions: string[], beforeAfterComparison }

availableActions.label: Verify Fix
availableActions.description: Independently verify a specific fix — re-derive answer, check explanation quality, confirm DL-### resolution.

dataInputs.verificationMethod: enum: INDEPENDENT_RECALCULATION | EXPLANATION_REVIEW | STRUCTURAL_CHECK | DIFF_COMPARISON | GOVERNANCE_GUARD_PASS

availableActions.uiComponent: form per finding (pass/fail toggle, method dropdown, notes)

availableActions.label: Verify DL-### Resolution
availableActions.description: Run the specific defect-class scan (e.g., DL-008 EW[CC] sweep) to confirm the defect class is resolved for all affected items.
preconditions: At least one ActionItem targeted a known DL-### defect class
dataOutputs: DefectVerificationResult { defectId, preScanCount, postScanCount, resolvedQids, remainingQids }

availableActions.label: Verify No Regression
availableActions.description: Confirm that fixes did not introduce new defects — run cross-defect scan for DL-008, DL-026, DL-013, DL-010 on modified items.
preconditions: At least one pack file modified

availableActions.label: Resolve Investigation
availableActions.description: All verification checks passed. Investigation is resolved.
preconditions: Validator suite shows zero new errors
All DL-### defect verifications show 0 remaining for targeted defect classes
availableActions.uiComponent: button (primary CTA — confirmation with summary field)

availableActions.label: Return to Executing
availableActions.description: Verification failed — go back to execute additional fixes.
preconditions: At least one verification check FAILED

sla.standard: Part of the 14-day FINDINGS_DRAFT → RESOLVED window
sla.critical: Part of the 7-day FINDINGS_DRAFT → RESOLVED window

RESOLVED.label: Resolved
RESOLVED.description: Investigation is resolved — all fixes applied, verified, and documented. Awaiting closure or archival.
entryCriteria: All verification checks passed
Resolution summary recorded
REVISION_HISTORY.md entry created (per AGENTS.md §4)
exitCriteria: Investigation closed via CLOSE_INVESTIGATION action
Or: re-opened to INVESTIGATING if new information surfaces

availableActions.label: Close Investigation
availableActions.description: Formally close the investigation. The resolution is final.
availableActions.uiComponent: button (primary CTA — confirmation with optional closing notes)

availableActions.label: Generate Resolution Report
availableActions.description: Generate a comprehensive resolution report summarizing the investigation from trigger to resolution.
dataOutputs: ResolutionReport { investigationSummary, findings, actions, beforeAfterComparisons, verificationEvidence, timeline }

availableActions.label: Reopen Investigation
availableActions.description: Reopen a resolved investigation — e.g., new information surfaced, fix was incomplete, or regression detected.

beforeAfterComparison.certificationImpact: string — e.g., '3 items re-certified', 'no certification impact'

CLOSED.label: Closed
CLOSED.description: Investigation is closed. Terminal state — no further actions possible (except reopen with permission).
entryCriteria: CLOSE_INVESTIGATION action executed
Closed timestamp recorded
exitCriteria: None (terminal state). Only REOPEN_INVESTIGATION can exit this state (transitions to INVESTIGATING).

availableActions.label: View Archive
availableActions.description: View the full investigation record (read-only). All data is preserved.

availableActions.label: Reopen Investigation
availableActions.description: Reopen a closed investigation. Requires REOPEN permission.

DISMISSED.label: Dismissed
DISMISSED.description: Investigation dismissed — no defect found, or finding is informational only with no remediation required.
entryCriteria: DISMISS_INVESTIGATION action executed from FINDINGS_REVIEW or TRIAGED state
Dismissal reason and type recorded
exitCriteria: None (terminal state). Reopen via REOPEN_INVESTIGATION only.

availableActions.label: View Dismissal Record
availableActions.description: View the full dismissal record (read-only).

availableActions.label: Reopen Investigation
availableActions.description: Reopen a dismissed investigation.

requiredData.dismissalType: enum: FALSE_POSITIVE | INFORMATIONAL_ONLY | OUT_OF_SCOPE | ACCEPTED_RISK | DUPLICATE

ESCALATED.label: Escalated
ESCALATED.description: Escalated to governance team. Investigation is now owned by governance — requires policy decision, certification block-listing, or systemic remediation.
entryCriteria: ESCALATE action executed from any non-terminal state
Escalation reason and governance impact recorded
exitCriteria: Governance team accepts escalation (remains ESCALATED until resolved)
Governance team creates derivative investigation(s) and closes this one
Or: governance team returns to INVESTIGATING with instructions

availableActions.label: Accept Escalation (Governance)
availableActions.description: Governance team formally accepts the escalation and assumes ownership.
availableActions.uiComponent: button (governance role only — with notes field)

availableActions.label: Resolve (Governance Decision)
availableActions.description: Governance team makes a final decision — may spawn derivative investigations, issue policy changes, or mark as no-action.

dataInputs.decision: enum: NO_ACTION | POLICY_CHANGE | CERTIFICATION_BLOCK | PACK_WIDE_REMEDIATION | DERIVATIVE_INVESTIGATION | OTHER

availableActions.uiComponent: form (modal — governance role only, comprehensive decision form)

availableActions.label: Return to Investigator
availableActions.description: Governance returns the investigation to the original investigator with instructions.

requiredData.governanceImpact: enum: CERTIFICATION | POLICY | PACK_WIDE | SCHEMA | SYSTEMIC

sla.escalationIfExceeded: Notify governance lead; auto-escalate to project lead

concurrentStateRules.duplicateBehavior: MERGE — new challenges for an already-investigated QID are appended to the OPEN investigation

dashboardLayout.description: Three-panel + bottom toolbar layout for the investigation workbench.

tabs.label: Overview

bottom.description: Context-sensitive action toolbar. Buttons change based on current state and user role.

behavior.primaryActions: 1-2 prominent buttons for the most likely next action in the current state
behavior.secondaryActions: dropdown menu with all available actions for the current state
behavior.utilityActions: always-available actions: RUN_FULL_DOSSIER, REFRESH, EXPORT, SHARE
behavior.stateIndicator: shows current state badge + SLA countdown
behavior.roleGating: actions are shown/hidden based on user role permissions (Board H)

investigationDetailViews.description: Content shown in the Overview tab of the center panel for each state.

additionalSections.heading: Question Dossier Summary
additionalSections.expandAction: Open full dossier in right panel

additionalSections.heading: Execution Log
additionalSections.entries: ExecutionRecord[] with timestamp, action, result, backupFile, governanceCheck

integrationPoints.description: How the Workbench connects to S252 backend engines and existing infrastructure.

boardA_QuestionInvestigationAPI.purpose: Generate full question dossier on demand.

request.includeOptions: enum[]: METADATA | EXPLANATIONS | HISTORY | HEALTH | SESSIONS

endpoints.cacheStrategy: Cache per QID, TTL 5 minutes, invalidated on any pack file modification

boardA_QuestionInvestigationAPI.uiIntegration: Button 'Run Full Dossier' in right panel and bottom toolbar. Results populate right panel §question-dossier section. Cached per investigation.

boardC_ChallengeTriageEngine.purpose: Auto-classify incoming challenges by severity, type, and priority.
boardC_ChallengeTriageEngine.uiIntegration: Auto-triggered on investigation creation. Manual re-run via 'Run Initial Triage' button. Results displayed in TRIGGERED/TRIAGED detail views.

boardD_InvestigationRegistry.purpose: Persist investigation state, lifecycle tracking, and audit trail.
boardD_InvestigationRegistry.uiIntegration: All state transitions write through the Registry. Left panel list loads from Registry GET /investigations with filters. Activity log tab reads from audit-log endpoint.

boardE_QuestionHealthEngine.purpose: Assess question health — severity, learner-pool impact, certification risk.
boardE_QuestionHealthEngine.uiIntegration: Button 'Run Health Assessment' in bottom toolbar (INVESTIGATING+). Results populate right panel §health-assessment section.

boardF_SessionIntelligence.purpose: Trace learner session exposure to affected questions.
boardF_SessionIntelligence.uiIntegration: Button 'Trace Session Impact' in bottom toolbar (INVESTIGATING+). Results populate right panel §session-trace section.

boardH_AdminDataContract.purpose: Enforce role-based permissions for all workbench actions.

integration.authentication: JWT-based — all API calls include Authorization header
integration.authorization: Per-action permission checks against role definitions

boardH_AdminDataContract.uiIntegration: All action buttons gated by role. Unauthorized actions are hidden or disabled with tooltip explaining required role.

governanceGuard.purpose: Pre-write and post-write validation for all pack-file modifications.

integration.preWriteGate: Before any EXECUTE_REMEDIATION action writes to a pack file, run governance guard pre-write check. BLOCK if Rule 2, Rule 5, or Rule 6 violation detected.
integration.postWriteGate: After every EXECUTE_REMEDIATION action, run governance guard post-write scan. Flag any regressions.

rules.rule5: Batch cap BLOCK — max 30 question objects per change-set without BLOCK-AUTHORIZED marker
rules.rule6: DL-026 BLOCK — empty/absent non-CC ExplanationWrong slots (deployed S814)

governanceGuard.uiIntegration: Governance guard status shown in right panel §governance-status section. VALIDATE_PLAN_GOVERNANCE action runs pre-flight check. Execution buttons disabled if any BLOCK-level rule would be violated. Post-write results shown in execution log.

slaDefinitions.description: Service Level Agreements for each investigation workflow stage.

FINDINGS_DRAFT_to_RESOLVED.note: Covers FINDINGS_DRAFT → FINDINGS_REVIEW → ACTION_PLANNED → ACTION_EXECUTING → ACTION_VERIFIED → RESOLVED

criticalSLA.description: All durations halved for CRITICAL severity investigations.

TRIGGERED_overdue.action: Notify lead investigator via dashboard alert and email

TRIAGED_overdue.action: Auto-escalate to team lead; re-queue with elevated priority

ASSIGNED_overdue.action: Flag as overdue; notify team lead; auto-reassign if no acknowledgement in +24h

INVESTIGATING_overdue.action: Auto-notify team lead; add to overdue queue; escalate to senior investigator if no progress in +3 days

ESCALATED_overdue.action: Notify governance lead; auto-escalate to project lead if no response in +24h

designNotes: This is a design document (Board I, S252). No executable code is produced.
The state machine defines 13 states with 28 defined transitions plus self-loops.
49 investigator actions are defined across all states plus 6 universal actions.
The dashboard uses a three-panel + bottom toolbar layout familiar to enterprise investigation tools.
All actions are role-gated via Board H (Admin Data Contract) permission enforcement.
All remediation writes are gated by governance guard pre-write and post-write validation.
SLA definitions are dual-track: standard and critical (halved durations).
The entity model defines 5 core record types for persistence via Board D (Investigation Registry).
Integration points connect to all 5 S252 backend boards plus governance guard.
This model is intended to guide UI implementation for a future investigation workbench.
